pairs.subject: register-bytecode-execution
pairs.evidence: src/components/guide/GuideMarkdown.tsx:14 The guide markdown is split into lines, parsed into a document tree (parseGuide), and rendered straight to React nodes by renderGuideDoc. Nothing compiles to an instruction stream or runs one, and searching src/components/guide and all of src/ for bytecode, opcode, interpreter, coroutine and regalloc found no hits, so this subject's precondition (a bytecode compiler or interpreter) does not hold.
